w_cmT20.expr: cross_mean(mul(div(sub(day_last(Close), day_first(Open)), day_first(Open)), abs_(sub(day_mean(in_sustain_stddev(is_gt(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume))), add(in_mean_full(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume)))), in_stddev_full(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume)))))), Ret, 5)), day_mean(in_sustain_stddev(is_lt(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume))), sub(in_mean_full(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume)))), in_stddev_full(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume)))))), Ret, 5))))), 20)
w_cmT20.why: 原式结构 + 窗口 20 盒式平滑。R1 numpy 固定 hl20 给 Ln +3.6%/+5.7%、与 v_base corr +0.896 —— 引擎里对不上就说明 numpy 的 roll_mean 和 cross_mean 不是一回事

w_cmD20.why: 把整条权重支路(成交量事件机器)删掉,只留日内收益 + 盒式平滑。R1 numpy 固定 hl20 给 Ln +4.9%/+7.4%,是全研究最高的多头腿 —— 领先候选

w_cmDsig20.why: 权重换成 1 个算子的日内波动。若与 w_cmD20 在 ±3 点内,说明长平滑下权重同样多余(H2)

w_cvxD20.expr: cross_mean(mul(div(sub(day_last(Close), day_first(Open)), day_first(Open)), abs_(div(sub(day_last(Close), day_first(Open)), day_first(Open)))), 20)
w_cvxD20.why: 权重换成 |D| 自己(C 段固定 hl20 的冠军 c6)。若明显高于 w_cmD20,说明带符号的凸化在长平滑下仍然有用(H4)

w_cmD60.why: 窗口换一档(邻域稳定性)。R1 numpy hl10 给 +4.6%/+6.5% —— 塌掉就说明窗口 20 是调出来的

w_cmD20lag10.why: 砍掉最近 10 天(H15)。lag profile 显示多头腿毛超额在 lag 0~10 为负、lag 20~40 才转正;若砍掉不变差而换手更低 ⇒ H15 成立,否则盒式平滑的好处纯粹是换手(H16)

w_cmDcc20.why: 日内收益换成收盘到收盘收益(H17)。若与 w_cmD20 的 rank corr > 0.9 且两本书在噪声内,候选就是普通的 20 日反转,是已知暴露
